claim_scope: Local Release-configuration build and bundle inspection with signing disabled. Nothing was signed, archived, uploaded or published, and no App Store Connect access was used.

control_run.delta_vs_before_fix: none: identical counts to the run before the guard fix, confirming the moved declarations are the same code and only their conditional-compilation scope changed

finding.before: The Release configuration did not compile: 5 errors, all the same defect class — production call sites referencing members declared only under #if DEBUG.
finding.cause: Every previous certification in this project ran the Debug configuration only, so a Debug-only declaration referenced from an unguarded production path could not fail until a Release build was attempted.
errors_before: AnalysisPipeline.swift:5193 cannot find 'updateIntentClarification' in scope (the CC-I05 intent API lived inside the #if DEBUG extension spanning lines 13750-15394 while publishLivePresentation calls it unconditionally)
CameraViewModel.swift:793 AnalysisPipeline has no member 'answerIntentClarification' (same extension)

SceneGeneratorViewModel.swift:1932/1933/1949 Self has no member 'generationLeaderFixtureHoldsSequence' / 'leaderActionHoldSeconds' (declared inside the #if DEBUG block at 857-881, used by the production leader sequence)
fix: Moved the four production intent members (recordIntentClarification, resetIntentClarificationSession, answerIntentClarification, updateIntentClarification) out of the #if DEBUG extension into a production extension; the testing accessors stay under #if DEBUG.

Moved generationLeaderFixtureArgument, generationLeaderFixtureHoldsSequence and leaderActionHoldSeconds out of the #if DEBUG block in SceneGeneratorViewModel; the fixture-only behaviour is unchanged because it still activates only through the -SHAFIN_GENERATOR_LEADER_FIXTURE launch argument.

release_build.signing: CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO (no certificate needed, nothing was signed or published)
